nodes.description: Payable constructor of UniswapExchange: sets name/symbol/totalSupply, assigns owner=msg.sender, mints full supply to deployer and grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value); payability plus forwarding masks the token as an exchange.
Core transfer routine: charge allowance when msg.sender!=_from, run ensure() gate, then move balances with unchecked subtraction/addition and increment _onSaleNum.
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI router, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale senders, otherwise forces condition() to pass.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any checks.
Internal view sale-limiter that reads _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale/_onSaleNum to decide whether a transfer is allowed.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall into attacker supplied address with attacker supplied calldata.
Backdoor mint: restricted to owner or hardcoded address, sets balanceOf[spender]=addedValue*10**decimals, marks canSale[spender]=true.
Owner-only initialiser for _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum sale parameters.
Owner-only batch transfer; computes uint total=_value*_tos.length unchecked and credits recipients in a loop.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress, which is whitelisted inside ensure().
Internal pure deterministic Uniswap pair address computation used by ensure().
Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances; written with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom/batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances; decremented with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
Private privileged owner address controlling _mints, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Total token supply set once in the constructor.
Whitelisted trading address writable by owner and bypassing condition() in ensure().
Mapping(address=>bool) whitelist granting unrestricted transfers; set by _mints.
Private per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition().
Private sale count limit configured by init and read by condition().
Private minimum sale amount configured by init and read by condition().
Private maximum sale amount configured by init and read by condition().
Constant public decimals = 18, used as the scaling exponent in the constructor and _mints.
msg.sender: untrusted caller used for privilege checks (owner/UNI comparisons) and as the acting account in transfer/approve/transferFrom.
delegatecall into attacker chosen address with chosen calldata executed in the token's storage context.
Unchecked uint subtraction/addition: allowance[_from][msg.sender]-=_value, balanceOf[_from]-=_value, balanceOf[_to]+=_value (Solidity 0.5 without SafeMath).
Unchecked multiplication uint total=_value*_tos.length and unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender]-=total.
Unchecked multiplication addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) used to set arbitrary balances.
Low-level address(token).call(data) in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn, an external call into an arbitrary token.
SafeERC20 helper performing a low-level call to a token and decoding an optional bool return.
Address library helper using extcodehash to check whether an address is a contract.
ERC20 internal transfer using SafeMath and emitting Transfer.
ERC20 internal mint increasing _totalSupply and _balances with SafeMath.
Context helper returning msg.sender as address payable.
Parameter _to of UniswapExchange.transfer, forwarded to transferFrom as recipient.
Parameter _value of UniswapExchange.transfer, amount forwarded to transferFrom.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, the debited account and the account checked for sale limits.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, the credited recipient.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, amount debited/credited and used in allowance arithmetic.
Parameter _from of ensure, compared against owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress and canSale.
Parameter _value of ensure, passed to condition() for min/max sale checks.
Local _UNI in ensure, the pairFor-computed pair address used in the whitelist comparison.
Parameter _from of condition, used to index _onSaleNum.
Parameter _value of condition, compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
Parameter a of delegate, the target address of the raw delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate, the calldata forwarded to the delegatecall target.
Parameter spender of _mints, the account credited with arbitrary balance and marked canSale.
Parameter addedValue of _mints, multiplied unchecked by 10**decimals to set balanceOf[spender].
Parameter saleNum of init, written into _saleNum.
Parameter token of init, scaled by 10**decimals into _minSale.
Parameter maxToken of init, scaled by 10**decimals into _maxSale.
Parameter _tos of batchSend, array of recipients looped over.
Parameter _value of batchSend, per-recipient amount multiplied unchecked by _tos.length.
Local total = _value * _tos.length, computed without overflow protection.
Local loop index i of the batchSend for-loop.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress, written into the whitelisted tradeAddress state variable.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed by transfer() into transferFrom as the source account.
msg.sender is compared with _from and used as the spender in allowance[_from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the untrusted caller.
delegate relies on require(msg.sender == owner) for privilege enforcement.
_mints authorises msg.sender against owner or a hardcoded address before minting arbitrary balances.
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass-transferring balances.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner to set the whitelisted trading address.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the total supply to the deployer.
The account reaching the delegatecall is gated only by msg.sender == owner.
Context._msgSender returns the raw msg.sender value.
transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom().
transferFrom invokes ensure() as a validity gate before moving balances.
ensure() calls condition() when the sender is not whitelisted.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic without SafeMath.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] by _value.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
ensure() treats _from or _to equal to owner as unconditionally allowed.
ensure() whitelists _from == tradeAddress.
ensure() whitelists canSale[_from].
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition() reads _saleNum to decide whether sale limits are active.
condition() compares _value with _minSale.
condition() compares _value with _maxSale.
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall into an untrusted address, allowing external code to run in the token's storage context.
delegate() gates the delegatecall with require(msg.sender == owner).
_mints computes addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) without overflow protection.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the computed amount.
_mints authorises the caller against owner before minting.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting unrestricted transfers.
init writes the scaled token parameter into _minSale.
init writes the scaled maxToken parameter into _maxSale.
init writes saleNum into _saleNum.
batchSend multiplies _value by _tos.length and subtracts the product without SafeMath.
batchSend debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits balanceOf[_to] for every recipient.
batchSend is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress writes the caller supplied address into tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
The constructor sets the privileged owner to msg.sender.
The constructor sets totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals).
The constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
The constructor grants allowance[msg.sender][UNI router] = uint(-1).
callOptionalReturn performs an external low-level call into a token contract, enabling callbacks into the caller.
callOptionalReturn requires address(token).isContract() before calling out.
ERC20._transfer writes the internal _balances mapping of the ERC20 contract.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only a per-call recipient argument that is immediately forwarded to transferFrom, so it can be merged into transfer.
_value is a per-call amount argument consumed only by transfer, so it can be merged into transfer.
_from is a per-call account argument used exclusively by transferFrom for balance, allowance and sale-limit logic.
_to is a per-call recipient argument used exclusively by transferFrom when crediting balances.
_value is a per-call amount argument consumed only by transferFrom arithmetic and checks.
_from is the address evaluated against the whitelist inside ensure only.
_value is the amount handed to condition() by ensure only.
_UNI is a transient computed pair address used only in the ensure whitelist comparison.
_from is only used to index _onSaleNum within condition.
_value is only compared against _minSale/_maxSale within condition.
a is the delegatecall target argument, meaningful only inside delegate.
b is the raw calldata of the delegatecall, so it belongs to the unsafe delegatecall operation.
spender is the account keyed into balanceOf and canSale inside _mints only.
addedValue is the operand of the unchecked multiplication that sets the minted balance.
saleNum is only stored into _saleNum by init.
token is only scaled and stored into _minSale by init.
maxToken is only scaled and stored into _maxSale by init.
_tos is the recipient array iterated over only inside batchSend.
_value is the per-recipient amount consumed only inside batchSend.
total is the unchecked product _value*_tos.length, directly tied to the arithmetic unsafe operation.
i is the transient loop counter of the batchSend for-loop.
addr is only assigned to tradeAddress inside setTradeAddress.
